description: Use this to answer: "What PC games are cheap right now?", "Which games are at their lowest price ever?", "What is leaving Game Pass soon?". Ranked discovery lists at the real checkout price: under_5 (games under the 5 USD tier, shown in the region's currency), historical_low (at their all-time low now) or leaving_game_pass (leaving within 30 days, with the cheapest price to buy instead). Not for a specific game: use get_cheapest_way_to_play.

currency.description: Currency: USD, EUR, GBP or TRY. Default is the region's currency.

region.description: Region: tr, us, eu or gb. Default: detected from the caller's IP, us when unknown.

name: list_deals
